title: Case 050: Bedroom Window Repair
initial_request: Bedroom window not shutting, handle not engaging.
overview: The tenant reported that the bedroom window handle turned but did not engage, leaving the window unable to close properly. The agency sought landlord approval, arranged for a maintenance provider to inspect and repair it, and later told the landlord the repair was complete and sent an invoice. The request was closed after checks were completed.
outcome: The bedroom window repair was completed. The agency informed the landlord and sent an invoice for their records; the request was then closed.
